interface.longDescription: Arcads helps marketers and creative teams research competitor ads, adapt video hooks and static ads for their brands, and generate or edit image, video, and audio assets through the Arcads MCP server. The bundled skills guide creative preparation and tool selection. An Arcads account is required for generation, which may consume Arcads credits. Competitor research may require a connected browser automation tool.
